_meta.description: Machine-readable companion to 'Event Astrology: A Compendium of Aspects — Consolidated Evaluation Reference'. One entry per (event, symbol) pair.
_meta.scoring: tier_score in {0,2,4,6,8,10}; per-source fields are 0/1/2 or null (source could not address this symbol at all for any event in the compendium). tier_score = round_to_nearest_tier( 10 * sum(applicable per-source values) / (2 * count(applicable sources)) ), where 'applicable' excludes any source scored null. Ties at an exact tier midpoint (raw score ending in .5 relative to the {0,2,4,6,8,10} scale) round up to the higher tier — see Methodology §3.4.
_meta.dagger_meaning: at_structural_ceiling (rendered as † in the prose document) is true only when the number of sources that could address this symbol at all is reduced below the full four (i.e. sources_applicable < 4, per §3.3's structural scope limits) AND every one of those applicable sources scored it 1 or 2 — full agreement among a necessarily smaller panel. A symbol with all 4 sources applicable is never marked, even if all 4 agree, because there is no reduced panel to flag in that case. The mark is NOT a strength indicator and does NOT imply a high tier_score: a symbol can be at_structural_ceiling=true with a low tier_score if the applicable sources agreed only weakly (e.g. all scored 1 rather than 2). Always read tier_score and the per-source 0/1/2 fields alongside this flag, not in place of it.
_meta.sample_size_fields: n_juan_combos_total and n_marr_examples_total are event-level totals (constant across all symbols within one event) attached to every symbol record so no downstream consumer needs to look elsewhere. They are NOT folded into tier_score in any way — a tier_score of 8 from n=1 and a tier_score of 8 from n=65 are both exactly 8; the sample-size fields are what let a reader distinguish them.
_meta.juan_marr_threshold_rule: Replaces the old flat 35%-of-total cutoff for Juan Combos (f) and Marr Aspects (g). See Methodology §3.2a for the full derivation; summary: score 2 requires (a) an absolute count of at least 3 occurrences AND (b) a Wilson-lower-bound-adjusted share at or above 0.35, which scales the effective share requirement upward as n shrinks (e.g. ~75% required at n=4, ~50% at n=16-18, converging toward ~35-42% by n=60-80) rather than applying a flat percentage regardless of how many total combinations/examples exist.
_meta.aggregation: This export contains NO aspect-level or cross-symbol fusion of any kind. Each symbol's tier_score is reported independently. There is no MIN/AVERAGE/etc. combining function in this document or export — two symbols' scores are looked up separately by whatever consumes this data.
